title: The Cloud and the Pure Soul in the Upper Zone
description: T85 names three states of perception that bear influx, each rising from a different source in the natural and bearing the proprium's claim in a different form: from love (kindled as fire, stripping itself onto whatever it falls upon, consuming), from truth-in-the-natural (manifested as thunder and lightning, falling as frost and hail upon what was growing), from thought (vehement winds wrecking the doctrinal vessels). A fourth, the conjoined air, descends gathering all wandering states into itself for refining. The Lord's discriminating operations strike at the appointed hour. T86 describes the pure soul as a tilled field set within the entire upper Zone, with two great Luminaries working over her as farmers from above — drawing her upward by likeness, that wherever she is they reach down to find her, until she comes to the Height.
